messages:
maya: Hi team, quick ask before I start next week: I have a rollover question. I moved between gigs last year and now have a small IRA + a 401(k) at my previous employer. Can I roll both into Redwood? Also wondering about Roth conversions if I roll an after-tax IRA piece in. cc @kevin

kevin (People Ops): Welcome! :wave: Short: yes you can roll an IRA and a 401(k) into our plan, but the tax treatment matters. If part of your IRA is after-tax basis (non-deductible), rolling that into a pre-tax 401(k) can create issues unless handled correctly. Nancy will add details.

nancy (Benefits): Practical steps: we accept trustee-to-trustee transfers or checks payable to the plan trustee. For mixed-basis IRAs, two options: 1) roll pre-tax portion to the 401(k) and leave/roll after-tax basis to a Roth IRA, or 2) perform a pro-rata rollover — both have tax implications. If you intend a Roth conversion, you'll owe tax on the converted pre-tax amount. Please upload your rollover paperwork to Workday > Benefits > Documents and DM me the account types. Our team reviews in ~3 business days.

sam (Payroll): Quick payroll notes: enroll in Workday for deferrals before the payroll cutoff (5th of month 23:59 PT) for the following cycle. Rollover processing and payroll elections are independent: your elective deferrals start per payroll enrollment; rolled-in balances do not affect match retroactively. Also, plan allows participant loans (subject to plan limits) — loan setup takes a couple payroll cycles.

maya: Got it, thanks. If I choose to convert after-tax IRA money to Roth and pay tax, can I still roll the Roth portion into the 401(k)?

nancy (Benefits): Most 401(k) plans accept designated Roth rollovers but policies differ. We accept Roth rollovers into the Roth account if the paperwork identifies it as Roth. If you convert then roll, confirm form shows Roth conversion details. DM me your current provider and I'll confirm the exact transfer string.

kevin (People Ops): Also FYI on vesting: employer match vests on a graded 4-year schedule (25%/yr). Match is applied to future deferrals only. If you have any prior service to be credited, mention it when you upload docs.

hr-bot: Onboarding checklist: "Upload rollover docs" step added, Benefits enrollment reminder scheduled for day 1. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/onboarding

maya: Thanks y'all, uploading the PDFs now and will DM @nancy the provider info. Appreciate the clarity!
